eyebrow.zh: 贴脚本 · 一键出片 · 免剪辑
eyebrow.en: Paste a script · One-click video · No editing

headline.zh:
写完脚本，就是成片
一条命令直发知识区
headline.en:
Script done, video ready
One command to a shippable 知识区 video

sub.zh: 贴一段 markdown 脚本，自动配旁白、烧字幕、排引用卡片，直接出 16:9 成片和封面。
sub.en: Paste a markdown script — narration, burned-in subtitles and quote cards are laid out for you, and a 16:9 video plus cover comes out.

body.zh: 贴上脚本，旁白、字幕、引用卡片、封面一次跑完，几分钟拿到能直发的 16:9 成片——不用打开剪辑软件。
body.en: Paste your script and narration, subtitles, quote cards and cover all render in one pass — a shippable 16:9 video in minutes, no editor open.

chips: › 出 MP4 + 封面 + 字幕

body.zh: 字幕跟着旁白的时间戳自动排好，每行不超 14 字、压在底部安全区，给弹幕留出节奏——不用手贴时间轴。
body.en: Subtitles lay out from the narration's own timestamps — ≤14 characters a line, pinned to the bottom safe area, leaving room for 弹幕 rhythm. No manual timeline sync.

chips: › 底部安全区 · 留弹幕位

body.zh: 引用标注卡、章节标题卡、16:9 封面都从脚本结构里长出来——你只管写正文，知识区的样子它都替你排好。
body.en: Quote callout cards, section title cards and a 16:9 cover all grow out of your script's own structure — you write the body, the knowledge-area look is laid out for you.

chips: › 引用卡 · 章节卡 · 封面

title.en: A local preview page, paste and go

body.zh: 本地起个网页，贴上脚本点生成，成片直接在页面上播——旁白、字幕、卡片都在，满意就下载。
body.en: Run a local page, paste a script, click generate — the finished video plays right on the page, narration and subtitles and cards all there. Download when it looks right.

chips: › 本地网页 · 贴脚本即出

headline.en: Script's done? Time to ship the video.

sub.zh: 开源、免费、可商用。一条命令装好，引擎跑在你自己机器上。
sub.en: Open-source, free, commercially usable. Install in one command; the engine runs on your own machine.

tag.en: ZhiCast — the script-to-video tool for B站 知识区 UP主 · MIT open-source
